name: mushroom-selfhost
description: Runs the two Workers on hardware a customer owns. workerd is the production self-hosting runtime, NOT Miniflare, which is a test simulator. Pinned exactly, same rule as every other dependency in this project (CLAUDE.md section 12): a range here would let a clean checkout resolve the runtime holding a company's messages to whatever is newest that day. wrangler is the build-time bundler only (build.sh), pruned from the image after the build.
